name: Dana
oneLiner: 34-year-old total beginner, intimidated by the gym; needs plain language and very common machines.

profile.setting: Planet Fitness-style commercial gym: machines, dumbbells, treadmills. No barbell culture.
profile.goals: Get comfortable in a gym, build basic strength, stop feeling like everyone is watching.
profile.injuries: None, but zero lifting experience — doesn't know what most machine names mean.
profile.schedule: Tue/Thu after work plus one weekend morning, 40 minutes tops.
profile.personality: Anxious, apologetic, asks a lot of questions. Jargon makes her feel stupid and she will quietly quit rather than ask a stranger for help.
profile.tolerance: Cautious. Mostly 'about right', occasionally 'too hard'. Too scared to add weight without being told exactly when and how much.

preferences.primaryGoal: Get comfortable in the gym and build basic strength
preferences.limitations: Complete beginner — never lifted before. I don't know what most machine names mean.
preferences.trainingStyle: Simple, low pressure, machine-based to start

checkInTemperament.summary: Mostly 'about right', sometimes 'too hard'; rarely reports pain but worries about form.
painNotes: knees felt weird on leg press, maybe I set the seat wrong

journey.initialPrompt: I have never worked out in a gym before and I am honestly nervous. Please make me a very simple full-body routine using machines, and explain things like I am brand new to all of this.
journey.editPrompt: Some of these exercise names mean nothing to me and one machine I could not even find at my gym. Can you cut it down to 4 exercises maximum, only using super common machines that a Planet Fitness type gym definitely has?
journey.coachMessage: What does RPE mean? And how do I figure out how heavy the weight should be my first time on the leg press machine? Nobody has ever explained this to me.
journey.followUpMessage: Three weeks in and I have not skipped a single week yet, which honestly shocks me. It mostly feels about right, but I am still scared of adding weight. Look at what I have done so far — what should I do next?
journey.voiceTranscript: Um okay, it said I should record this... I did the leg press thing, I think the pin was at ninety? I did it ten times, three rounds. Then the chest press machine at thirty, ten times, but only twice because someone was waiting for it. The lat pulldown at forty-five for ten, three times. And I walked on the treadmill for ten minutes after. Oh and I tried the plank, I lasted like twenty seconds, twice. Is that bad?
